description: March 20 birthday meaning: Pisces or Aries cusp, birthday number 2, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, March 20 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Pisces or Aries. In numerology the day gives birthday number 2, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: The March 20 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: The equinox birthday sits on a hinge. On March 20 the Sun is usually in the final degree of Pisces, but in many years it crosses into Aries during the day, so the birth time decides. Number 2 suggests diplomacy between the two moods: empathy meeting courage, reflection meeting action, in one temperament.

Astronomically, March 20 puts the Sun near 29° Pisces in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Pluto. A birthday around March 19 to March 21 sits on the cusp between Pisces and Aries, the seam where the zodiac ends and begins again. Strictly speaking nobody is half one sign: the Sun is in one or the other, and the exact moment it crosses into Aries shifts by a day or so depending on the year, the time of birth and the place. A full chart settles it. Many cuspers still relate to both, pairing Pisces' imagination and empathy with Aries' urge to act. The blend is often described as a dreamer who also starts things.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for March 20
paragraphs: A birthday on the 20th reduces as 2 + 0 = 2, giving a birthday number of 2. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 2, intensifying its sensitivity, diplomacy and emotional awareness. Those born on the 20th are frequently described as intuitive companions and natural team members, attuned to atmosphere and moods. They may pick up the feeling in a room before anyone has spoken. As a secondary number in the chart, the 20 tends to show in close relationships and group work. Protecting their own energy, and saying no kindly, is a recurring theme for this birthday.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a March 20 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous March 20 birthdays
paragraphs: A March birthday falls around the spring equinox for the northern hemisphere, the season of thaw and first growth, while southern birthdays mark the turn into autumn. The month is split between Pisces and Aries, with the change around March 20 or 21. In numerology March is month 3, linked with expression, creativity and sociability, a lively number for a month that ends with the zodiac starting over. March 20 is the 79th day of the year (80th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Aries, is usually complete within 1 day, by March 21.

By March 20 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a March 20 birthday are Henrik Ibsen (1828), Chester Bennington (1976) and Friedrich Hölderlin (1770).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is March 20?
faq.answer: March 20 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Pisces or Aries on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Pisces. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on March 20?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On March 20 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 4 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 2 for everyone born on the 20th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on March 20?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by March 20, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on March 20?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on March 20 include Henrik Ibsen (1828), Chester Bennington (1976) and Friedrich Hölderlin (1770). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
